author: Zegita
body:
I would like to appeal this infraction even if it just a warn. I was playing the semi-finals of the walls with my teammate and this guy called iTimeless was constantly speaking in the chat as the most cockiest person I have ever met. He kept stating that he would win the walls tourney blah blah and how that "this game will be an easy game" but I proved him wrong because I rekt him and his teammate but let's not go off-topic. He was harrassing me not directly but indirectly and it was just annoying me and I was getting angry because I had never met anyone so cocky before - I know I'm cocky at sometimes but not like this guy even Sethskye(Edans) was telling me how he was really cocky and that was bad. I am sorry for my behaviour for lashing out at him and swearing at him but everybody was supporting him and his teammate in the walls and it puts pressure on us because nobody is supporting us and it impacts how we play the game. I hope you understand what I mean but please I believe the problem was him because it was just as if he wanted to torment me and I was giving him a chance for about 30 minutes but then he said some things which was just annoying so I flipped out.

Please understand what I'm trying to explain I do believe the infraction should be lifted I don't believe that I am the fault of this. Thank you for reading and I hope you understand :).

title: Warn: Extreme rudeness and disrespect

replies.author: BoldAndBrash
replies.body:
Hey Zegita,

Although I do understand that they were making rude comments towards you, that is no reason to lash out. You could've simply reported the users or gathered evidence and made an online report. You were told my Edans numerous times to stop, but it seems you all kept going. All of you have received a warning, including Patrikano and  iTimeless. I'm sorry your infraction couldn't be appealed, but keep in mind it is simply a warn. If you have a rebuttal, feel free to say it.

Regards,
DaBaderMC
